subject: Subscription health & scalability check-in — utilization, perf, next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@skyhookai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Subscription health & scalability check-in — utilization, perf, next steps

Hi Elena,

Quick check-in on Skyhook's subscription health as we approach your renewal window next quarter. We pulled the usage & perf telemetry for the past 90 days and want to surface three things that will affect renewal/expansion discussions: 

1) Token trajectory: steady month-over-month growth (~24% MoM) driven by the new recommendations feature you rolled out in September. Q3 token_report attached.
2) Performance: 95th latency has increased from ~320ms to ~540ms on peak windows (18:00-22:00 ET). We suspect batching + KV-cache warming for longer contexts is contributing.
3) Cost mix: embeddings + reranking are now ~45% of spend versus 30% previously; unit economics shift we should account for in any commit.

Attachments: [Attachment: token_report_Q3.csv (csv)]

Proposed near-term next steps:
- 30-min sync this week to review the token report and confirm traffic seasonality
- Draft three expansion options (described at a high level below) for your team and procurement
- If you agree, we can run a short canary on Dedicated routing for the heavy inference path to verify p95 improvements before you lock a commit.

High-level options (for discussion):
- Option A: 20% commit uplift (6-month) + standard pricing; minimal change to routing
- Option B: 50% commit uplift (12-month) + 8% discount + Dedicated burst credits trial
- Option C: Enterprise Reserved (12–24 month) with custom latency SLOs and a pilot of the dedicated routing feature

Are you available for a 30-min call on Thursday 11/10 or Friday 11/11? If you'd prefer, send your team’s preferred windows and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — happy to walk through the CSV live.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@skyhookai.com>

Cc: ops@skyhookai.com
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Subscription health & scalability check-in — utilization, perf, next steps

Thanks Ben — this is really helpful. I pulled this into our ops channel and attached our internal perf dashboard snapshot for October. The latency increases line up with a backend rollout we did on 10/12 (new ranker + longer context vectors).

A few clarifying questions before the call:
- For Option B, can you share an estimated per-token unit price (after the 8% discount) and an example ROI for our current workload? We need to justify a commit to finance.
- What does the Dedicated "burst credits trial" look like operationally? How long, and what metrics do you measure?

We can do Thursday 11/10 at 10:30am ET. Attendees: me and Tom (ops).

Attachment: [Attachment: skyhook_perf_oct.pdf (pdf)]

Elena
Elena Park | Head of Product
Skyhook AI

Elena — great, 10:30am ET on Thu 11/10 is on the calendar. Brief answers to your questions so the call can be focused: 

- Option B economics (illustrative):
  • Current blended unit price: $0.00085 / token
  • Option B (50% uplift + 8% discount): ~$0.000782 / token (after discount)
  • Example ROI: with your current 3-month runrate (~1.2B tokens), the incremental commit reduces expected variable spend by ~13% over the year (model attached).

- Dedicated burst credits trial:
  • 30-day pilot, up to 200k concurrent inference tokens per day routed to Dedicated pool
  • Success metrics: 95th latency improvement >=20% and throughput stability under peak
  • Redwood provides the configuration and initial monitoring dashboards; Skyhook ops measures end-to-end p95 and error rates

Attached a short options workbook with the simple ROI tab and sensitivity on traffic growth. If the pilot proves out, we can fold the Dedicated profile into Option C commitments with SLA language.

Attachments: [Attachment: proposal-options.xlsx (xlsx)]

See you Thursday — I’ll come prepared with a model and a suggested canary plan for the Dedicated route.

Best,
Ben
